sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: dealer); size 483 x 184 x 133 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Universal Audio LA-2A manual (Adorama-hosted copy of the manufacturer manual), opened 2026-11-12: panel 19 in x 5.25 in, depth behind the panel 7.25 in (482.6 x 133.4 x 184.2 mm; the plan size is the same), audio input and output on XLR (600 ohm balanced, gender and panel not stated: input female and output male by convention, drawn on the rear), a 10-position barrier terminal strip (no catalogue connector, not modelled). The manual and the product page do not name the mains connector: no mains inlet is modelled, so the device has no power control. Chassis vents are not stated and are not modelled. Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, knobs and indicators drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess): no drawing or photo was opened. Connector genders not stated by the source follow the convention input = female, output = male.
UA LA-2A product page, opened 2026-11-12: 19 in rackmount chassis, 3U, 13 lb, Jones barrier terminals and XLR connectors.

Mains (review fix, read 2026-11-12 by a research pass): the older LA-2A manual never names the inlet; a search summary of UA's pages lists 35 W, 120 / 240 V, 50 / 60 Hz. No page read confirms the inlet connector or a switch, so none is modelled and the entry says so.
